about: The introitus of the formulary “Maternity of the Blessed Virgin Mary” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Behold, the Virgin will conceive and bear a Son, and His name will be called Emmanuel. Sing a new song to the Lord, for He has worked wonders. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen. Behold, the Virgin will conceive and bear a Son, and His name will be called Emmanuel.
